_description: Output schema for the hardcoded-secrets / password triager. The agent reads this file alongside SKILL.md and emits triage-output.json conforming to this shape. Placeholder strings in angle brackets describe expected content; for fields with a fixed enumeration, the placeholder shows the allowed values separated by ' | '.
category: <see SKILL.md Category rules; N/A for FALSE POSITIVE>
vulnerability_class: Hardcoded Secret | Hardcoded Password | Hardcoded API Key | Hardcoded Token
code_snippet: <3-5 lines with all sensitive values redacted per SKILL.md rules, leading // Line N-M comment>
pattern: <what the value looks like, e.g. high-entropy password, AWS key pattern, Base64 string>
context: <file type, location, surrounding code with values redacted>
encryption_details: <config details if encrypted, else empty string>
fallback_pattern: <the pattern if fallback default, else empty string>
risk_reduction_factors: <each factor as a sentence with technical evidence; empty array if none>
